examples.title: Headings
examples.description: Four sizes. Each style sets its own heading face: a serif in Editorial, hand lettering in Paper, Markdown marks in Terminal.

examples.title: Text
examples.description: A lead paragraph, body text with a link and inline code, muted text and small print.

examples.title: Prose
examples.description: Wrap Markdown or CMS output in .vin-prose and the plain tags inside are styled and spaced.

a11y: The look and the level are separate: use the heading tag that fits the page outline (one h1, then h2, h3…), and the class for the size.
Links are underlined, not only coloured, and have a visible focus ring.
Body and muted text meet 4.5:1 contrast in every style and mode.
Lists use real ul/ol elements, so screen readers say how many items there are.
